name: User
description: Users can log in, join groups and be granted specific permissions.

login.label: Email
login.description: Email address used to authenticate the user.
login.help: The email address is used as login.

username.label: Username
username.description: Unique username assigned to the account.
username.help: Enter a unique username containing letters, numbers, or single hyphens.

password.label: Password
password.help: Enter a new value only when the password must be changed.

nickname.label: Nickname
nickname.help: This value reflects the username assigned to the account.

fullname.label: Full name
fullname.description: Full name calculated from the given and family names.
fullname.help: This value is calculated automatically from the given and family names.

language.label: Language
language.help: Select the user's preferred interface language.

validated.label: Validated
validated.description: Indicates whether the user account has been validated.
validated.help: This value prevents the user from signing in until the account is validated.

groups_ids.label: Groups
groups_ids.description: Groups to which the user belongs.
groups_ids.help: Select the groups to which the user belongs.

permissions_ids.label: Permissions
permissions_ids.description: Permissions granted directly to the user.
permissions_ids.help: This list contains the permissions assigned directly to the user.

setting_values_ids.label: Setting values
setting_values_ids.help: This list contains the preferences and settings assigned to the user.

passkeys_ids.label: Passkeys
passkeys_ids.help: This list contains the passkeys registered for the user.

status.label: Status
status.description: Current state of the user account.
status.help: This value tracks the account through creation, validation, confirmation, or suspension.

allow_auth.label: Allow authentication
allow_auth.description: Allows password, passkey, or email authentication.
allow_auth.help: Disable this option to allow access only through manually generated access tokens.

access_tokens_ids.label: Access tokens
access_tokens_ids.description: Access tokens owned by the user.
access_tokens_ids.help: This list contains the access tokens issued to the user.

invalid_login.label: Incorrect login format: not a valid e-mail address

invalid_password.label: Incorrect password format: not an md5 value
